paite: Chiltang kitam ahihkeileh zahmoh atkhiak mi kuapeuh TOUPA mi kikhawmte lak ah atel ding ahi kei.
heading: TOUPA Mite A Pan Posiahna
english: He who is emasculated by crushing or cutting shall not enter into Yahweh’s assembly.

paite: TOUPA mi kikhawmte lak ah sawnta atel ding ahi kei. Suan sawm tan in asuante TOUPA mi kikhawmte lak ah atel ding ahi kei hi.
english: A person born of a forbidden union shall not enter into Yahweh’s assembly; even to the tenth generation shall no one of his enter into Yahweh’s assembly.

paite: Ammonte leh Moabte TOUPA mi kikhawmte lak ah atel ding uh ahi kei. Suan sawmna tan in alak ua mi TOUPA mi kikhawmte lak a, atel mahmah louh ding uh ahi.
english: An Ammonite or a Moabite shall not enter into Yahweh’s assembly; even to the tenth generation shall no one belonging to them enter into Yahweh’s assembly forever,

paite: Aigupta gam a pan na hong pawt lai ua tanghou leh tui a, ahon na dawn louh ziak un leh hon hamsiat dia Mesopotamia gam a Pethor a Beor tapa Balaam agoih ziak un.
english: because they didn’t meet you with bread and with water on the way when you came out of Egypt, and because they hired against you Balaam the son of Beor from Pethor of Mesopotamia, to curse you.

paite: Himahleh TOUPA na Pathian un Balaam thu angaikhe nuam kei; TOUPA na Pathian un nou ahon it ziak in TOUPA na Pathian un huai hamsia nou a ding in vualzawlna asuaksak zaw hi.
english: Nevertheless Yahweh your God wouldn’t listen to Balaam, but Yahweh your God turned the curse into a blessing to you, because Yahweh your God loved you.

paite: Na damsung teng un akhamuanna ding uh leh alohchinna ding uh na ngaihtuahpih ding uh ahi kei.
english: You shall not seek their peace nor their prosperity all your days forever.

paite: Edom mite na kih ding uh ahi kei, na unaute uh lah ahi ngal ua. Aigupta mite na kih ding uh ahi kei, agam ua mikhual na hih tak ziak un.
english: You shall not abhor an Edomite, for he is your brother. You shall not abhor an Egyptian, because you lived as a foreigner in his land.

paite: Asuan uh thumna a pan TOUPA mi kikhawmte lak ah atel ding uh ahi.
english: The children of the third generation who are born to them may enter into Yahweh’s assembly.

paite: Na melmate uh dou dia giahphual na sat chiang un thilsiang lou chiteng a pan na kihuikhiak ding uh ahi.
heading: Sepaih Giahphual Kep Sianthouna
english: When you go out and camp against your enemies, then you shall keep yourselves from every evil thing.

paite: Na lak ua kuapeuh zan chiang a amah a pan chi apawt ziak a thanghuai na om uleh, giahphual a pan apawt dia, giahphual ah alut nawn ding ahi kei.
english: If there is among you any man who is not clean by reason of that which happens to him by night, then shall he go outside of the camp. He shall not come within the camp;

paite: Himahleh ni ahong kai chiang in, akisil dia; nitum chiang in giahphual ah alut nawn ding ahi.
english: but it shall be, when evening comes, he shall bathe himself in water. When the sun is down, he shall come within the camp.

paite: Giahphual polam ah zun leh ek thakna ding mun na sep ding uh ahi.
english: You shall have a place also outside of the camp where you go relieve yourself.

paite: Na vanzat lak uah ninluahna na nei ding ua; hichi ahi ding a, na dailen chiang un, huai in lei na khuak ding ua, zun leh ek na thak uh na vuk nawn ding uhi.
english: You shall have a trowel among your weapons. It shall be, when you relieve yourself, you shall dig with it, and shall turn back and cover your excrement;

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un lah na giahphual uah nou hon humbit ding leh na melmate uh hon pe ding in ahong tel ngal a. Huaiziak in na giahphual uh asiangthou ding ahi. Huchi lou in zaw na lak ua thilsiang lou amu dia, hon paimangsan ding hi.
english: for Yahweh your God walks in the middle of your camp, to deliver you, and to give up your enemies before you. Therefore your camp shall be holy, that he may not see an unclean thing in you, and turn away from you.

paite: Na kiang ua sikha, apu hon taikhiaksan na pekik nawn ding uh ahi kei.
heading: Dan Tuamtuam
english: You shall not deliver to his master a servant who has escaped from his master to you.

paite: Na omna ua adeihpen atel peuhpeuh ah na lak uah a-om sam ding ahi. Amah na nuaisiah ding uh ahi kei.
english: He shall dwell with you, among you, in the place which he shall choose within one of your gates, where it pleases him best. You shall not oppress him.

paite: Israel tanute lak ah kizuak a-om ding ahi kei a, Israel tapate lak ah leng pasal kizuak a-om ding ahi kei.
english: There shall be no prostitute of the daughters of Israel, neither shall there be a sodomite of the sons of Israel.

paite: Kizuakna man hiam, toko man hiam thuchiamna ding in TOUPA na Pathian inn ah na tawi ding uh ahi kei. TOUPA na Pathian uh a ding in thilkihhuai ahi.
english: You shall not bring the hire of a prostitute, or the wages of a male prostitute, into the house of Yahweh your God for any vow; for both of these are an abomination to Yahweh your God.

paite: Apung delh in na unau na leitawisak ding ahi kei. Dangka lam a pung hiam, nek ding lam a pung hiam, bangpeuh apung delh a leitawisak louh ding ahi.
english: You shall not lend on interest to your brother: interest of money, interest of food, interest of anything that is lent on interest.

paite: Gamdang mite bel apung delh in na leitawisak thei ding uh. Himahleh na unaute apung delh in na leitawisak ding ahi kei. Huchi in na va luah ding uh gam a na khut ngakna tengteng uah TOUPA na Pathian un hon vualzawl ding hi.
english: You may charge a foreigner interest; but you shall not charge your brother interest, that Yahweh your God may bless you in all that you put your hand to, in the land where you go in to possess it.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh kiang a thu na chiam un sawt hal lou in na pe pah ding uh ahi. TOUPA na Pathian un lah hon phut ngei ding ahi ngal a. Khial in na moh kha ding hi.
english: When you vow a vow to Yahweh your God, you shall not be slack to pay it, for Yahweh your God will surely require it of you; and it would be sin in you.

paite: Thuchiam lam a na kidek uleh nou a ding in khelhna ahi kei ding.
english: But if you refrain from making a vow, it shall be no sin in you.

paite: Na kam ua pawtsa na hih ding uh ahi: Ut thu a thillat na kam ua na chiam uh TOUPA na Pathian uh kiang a na chiam bang ua na lat pah ding uh ahi.
english: You shall observe and do that which has gone out of your lips. Whatever you have vowed to Yahweh your God as a free will offering, which you have promised with your mouth, you must do.

paite: Na invengte grephuan a na hoh chiang un na deih zah uh na ne ding ua, himahleh na seng ua na guan louh ding uh ahi.
english: When you come into your neighbor’s vineyard, then you may eat your fill of grapes at your own pleasure; but you shall not put any in your container.

paite: Na invengte buh ding lai mun a na hoh chiang un avui na khiak thei ding uh. Himahleh na invengte buh ding lai ah kawite na zang ding uh ahi kei hi.
english: When you come into your neighbor’s standing grain, then you may pluck the ears with your hand; but you shall not use a sickle on your neighbor’s standing grain.
